## Security Dashboard
Secure Score trend, high-severity Defender alerts, Key Vault access anomalies, and Azure Firewall deny-rate — the four panels from Section 4.6 of the companion article.

content.query:
SecureScores
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| summarize AvgPercentageScore = avg(PercentageScore) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Secure Score trend (30 days)

content.query:
SecurityAlert
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where AlertSeverity == "High"
| project TimeGenerated, AlertName, CompromisedEntity, Description
| order by TimeGenerated desc
content.title: High-severity Defender alerts (7 days)

content.query:
AzureDiagnostics
| where ResourceProvider == "MICROSOFT.KEYVAULT"
| where OperationName == "SecretGet"
| project TimeGenerated, CallerIPAddress, identity_claim_upn_s, requestUri_s, ResultSignature
| order by TimeGenerated desc
content.title: Key Vault secret access audit

content.query:
AzureDiagnostics
| where Category == "AzureFirewallNetworkRule"
| where msg_s contains "Deny"
| parse msg_s with * "from " SourceIP " to " DestinationIP ":" DestinationPort " " *
| summarize DeniedAttempts = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Firewall deny-rate (hourly)
